title: The Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework, version 3: the average template brain and the 2017 annotation volume, at 50 and 25 micrometres, and the structure ontology that names every label
credit: Mouse brain: Allen Mouse Brain Atlas, CCFv3 (Wang et al. 2020)
format: NRRD (gzip-encoded): the template as unsigned 16-bit intensities, the annotation as unsigned 32-bit structure ids, 528 x 320 x 456 voxels at 25 um and 264 x 160 x 228 at 50 um. The voxel axes run anterior to posterior, superior to inferior and left to right (PIR) from the volume's corner, in micrometres; the files' headers say left-posterior-superior, which the domain overrides (neuroscience/js/spaces.js). The ontology is the JSON of the API's structure_graph_download for graph 1 (the adult mouse brain): a tree of 1,327 structures with id, acronym, name, colour and children. neuroscience/js/nrrd.js and labels.js read them.
licence: Allen Institute Terms of Use (https://alleninstitute.org/terms-of-use/), which ask that the Allen Mouse Brain Atlas be cited; fetched into the cache, not redistributed.
citation: Wang, Q. et al. (2020), The Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework: a 3D reference atlas, Cell 181(4), 936-953, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2020.04.007. Allen Institute for Brain Science (2011), Allen Reference Atlas - Mouse Brain, atlas.brain-map.org.
